title: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
titleRomaji: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
titleNative: 网游：我能进化一切
synonyms: Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything
synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

titleNative: 商い人魚と蒼空の初恋
synonyms: The Trading Mermaid and Sora’s First Love
The Trading Mermaid and Blue Sky's First Love
synopsis: Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “Trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option… One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden. He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…!? A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: KaguRai: Kagura to Raito

synopsis: Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the sword. And Raito is a boy who belongs to a race called "Hito-youkai" that is hated by the people. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A one-shot story in the Sunday magazine received such a great response that it has been decided to serialize it! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!! (Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title: Ore ga Iku made Eien no Ai wo Chikae

titleNative: 俺が逝クまで永遠の愛を誓え
synonyms: Promise Everlasting Love Until I Die
OreIku
俺イク
synopsis: I’ve always hated Kazama. We joined the company at the same time and were rivals — I believed I wasn’t inferior to him in any way, but what awaited me at the end of that path was a demotion from my department... In that moment when everything I believed in was shattered, I headed to the company rooftop with a resolve in my heart, but the words that came out of that guy’s mouth were: “Marry me before you jump so I can get the insurance money”. Filled with rage, I went along with Kazama’s scheme, but as I gradually came to understand his charm, I ended up giving in to the moment and sleeping with him. Now, I, a straight guy, am getting corrupted by that scumbag... (Source: Daitosha, translated)

title: Hikari no Densetsu
titleNative: 光の伝説
synonyms: Legend of Hikari
Legend of Light
Hilary
La leggenda di Hikari
Cynthia ou le Rythme de la Vie
synopsis: It's about a girl named Hikari Kamijou who dreams of becoming a national rhythmic gymnastics champion. Hikari no Densetsu is primarily a love story that it is set in the late 80s junior high school atmosphere. The plot revolves around four characters and how they work to achieve their dreams. Hikari Kamijou, a young, naïve, care-free, young woman who dreams of becoming an Olympic Champion in the sport of rhythmic gymnastics ever since she witnessed a performance of the young Diliana Georgieva (a champion Bulgarian rhythmic gymnast). And while she performs poorly and is not very confidant in her skills as a rhythmic gymnast, she is very passionate about the sport and shows occasional brilliance during her performances. From Wikipedia
